options.b: Chi mmadụ na-ewe iwe mgbe niile
options.c: Mmadụ kwesịrị ịgbazite nkụ n'aka agbataobi ya
options.d: Mmadụ kwesịrị inye chi ya nri kwa ụbọchị

explanation: Ilụ a na-akụzi na mgbe mmadụ mere mbọ ya ma kwadebe onwe ya, chi ya (ihe chi/hemenke) ga-enyere ya aka na mmezu ebumnuche ya.
